discordPostHtml:
Mod by: Shadow Light

"Fighters were sick of only being deployed when attached to carriers, so they evolved into their own ships."

Adds a bunch of frigates that are upscaled from vanilla fighters, distributed among the vanilla factions. The frigates' DP matches more or less matches their originals' OP cost, and their power is adjusted accordingly. All of the frigates also carry a single wing of their respective fighter type.

Yes, this was worth taking the time to translate, why do you ask?

Download link: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1jie8F3V4oiafjbCANUEQP0zenKPY-EgU

Changes for 1.0.3:

  • A lot of balance changes (check the changelog file)
  • Some adjusted variants
  • Updated for 0.97 (obviously)
